strings.name: Hans Zimmer
strings.summary: Born in Frankfurt, Zimmer later worked in British pop music and film scoring, learning film music production through collaboration with Stanley Myers. He combines electronics, orchestra and team-based recording in scores including Rain Man, The Lion King, Inception and Dune, winning two original-score Oscars. Tours also spread his music; the work depends on performers, producers and collaborators.

strings.facts.f2.value: Attended Hurtwood House in Britain; developed musical skills largely through self-study and collaborative practice.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Electronics and orchestra
strings.highlights.h1.text: Uses synthesizers, orchestra and recording production together to shape cinematic sound narratives.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Sharing film music
strings.highlights.h2.text: Signature scores and live performances broaden audiences for film music through professional teamwork.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Dune wins Oscar
strings.timeline.t1.text: Won his second Academy Award for the original score of the 2021 film Dune.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Interstellar
strings.timeline.t2.text: Scored the film, using organ and other sounds to help shape its cosmic and family themes.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Inception
strings.timeline.t3.text: Combined electronic and orchestral music to create a sonic experience of time and dreams.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Gladiator
strings.timeline.t4.text: With Lisa Gerrard and other collaborators, shaped the film’s musical and vocal atmosphere.
strings.timeline.t5.title: The Lion King wins Oscar
strings.timeline.t5.text: Won his first Academy Award for the animated film’s original score.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Rain Man score
strings.timeline.t6.text: Earned his first Oscar nomination for the score, then expanded his Hollywood work.
strings.timeline.t7.title: British pop music
strings.timeline.t7.text: Worked in Britain’s music scene and appeared in the music video for a song by The Buggles.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Frankfurt
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Germany, later studied and worked in music in Britain, laying foundations for an international career.
